enriched.title: Vocabulário, Gramática e Pronúncia em Inglês
enriched.summary: A aula aborda vocabulário relacionado a tecnologia, saúde e emoções, além de gramática e pronúncia. Também explora verbos irregulares e suas conjugações.

vocabulary.definition: Feeling sad because one has no friends or company.
examples: He felt lonely after moving to a new city.

vocabulary.definition: An arrangement to receive something, typically a product or service, regularly.
examples: I have a subscription to several video game platforms.

vocabulary.definition: Evoking admiration through size, quality, or skill.
A medical practice involving inserting needles into the skin to relieve pain or treat conditions.
examples: Many people use acupuncture for stress relief.
The movie was too scary for the children.

vocabulary.definition: At the present time, in contrast with the past.
examples: Nowadays, people rely heavily on technology.

vocabulary.definition: A unique feature that sets something apart.
examples: Technical expertise with the human touch is their key differentiator.

vocabulary.definition: Made or adapted for a particular purpose or person.
examples: The service is tailored to meet individual needs.

vocabulary.definition: To take or go with someone or something to a place.
examples: Can you bring me a glass of water?

vocabulary.definition: Past tense and past participle of 'bring'.
examples: She brought her homework to class.

vocabulary.definition: Moving in one side and out of the other side.
The continuous physical force exerted on or against an object.
examples: The pressure to succeed can be overwhelming.

vocabulary.definition: To convince someone to do something.
examples: I need to persuade our clients to use our products.

vocabulary.definition: Difficult to understand or deal with.
examples: The instructions were too complicated for beginners.

vocabulary.definition: To be given a name or referred to by a specific term.
examples: They are called programmers who do vibe coding.

grammar.explanation: Verbos irregulares não seguem o padrão comum de conjugação no passado e no particípio passado.
rules: O verbo 'bring' é conjugado como 'bring - brought - brought'.
Os verbos irregulares devem ser memorizados individualmente, já que não seguem um padrão fixo.
examples: Bring – brought – brought: trazer – trouxe – trazido
commonMistakes: Confundir formas regulares e irregulares, como 'bringed' ao invés de 'brought'.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete with the correct form of the verb: She ____ her laptop to the meeting.
practiceQuestions.explanation: 'Brought' é o passado de 'bring', usado para indicar uma ação já realizada.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate to English: 'Nós precisamos convencer os clientes a usar nossos produtos.'
practiceQuestions.answer: We need to persuade our clients to use our products.
practiceQuestions.explanation: A frase utiliza o verbo 'persuade', que significa 'convencer'.

studyTips: Revise os verbos irregulares diariamente para memorizá-los mais facilmente.
Pratique a pronúncia das palavras novas usando aplicativos ou gravações para verificar a sua entonação.
originalExamples: They are called programmers who do vibe coding. (Eles são chamados de programadores que fazem codificação de vibe.)
I need to persuade our clients to use our products. (Eu preciso persuadir nossos clientes a usar nossos produtos.)
Bring – brought – brought: trazer – trouxe – trazido.
